player_prompt.intro:
Yu pilai {color} long wanpela gem bilong Breakthrough. Yu go {direction} long wanpela bod long saiz {board_size}x{board_size}.
Long turn bilong yu, yu ken muv wanpela pisi wanpela step i go pas or i go pas long diagonal.
Wanpela pisi inap muv long diagonal tasol sapos i gat pisi bilong arapela man, na inap muv i go insait long wanpela skwea bilong arapela man long diagonal step.
Sapos yu go insait long wanpela skwea bilong arapela man, yu kisim pisi bilong en, na pisi bilong arapela man bai go pinis long bod.
Yusim notation olsem UCI long braket, olsem [a2a3] bilong muv long a2 i go a3.
* 'a' em i kolom long lek, '1' em i raun bilong bawah (long ai bilong White).
* Raun bilong haus bilong Black em i raun bilong antap (raun 8 long bod 8x8). Raun bilong haus bilong White em i raun bilong bawah (raun 1 long bod 8x8).
Wanpela man husat pisi bilong en i kisim raun bilong haus bilong arapela man, em i win. Sapos ol pisi bilong yu ol i kisim pinis, yu lus.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Plis yusim bracketed algebraic notation olsem [a2a3].
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Yu mekim move i go ausait long boda.
invalid_move.illegal: Dispela pasin i no stret wantaim lo bilong Bratauk o em i no samting yu inap mekim.

outcome.white_reached: Ol waitpela i kamap long ples ol blakskin i go.
outcome.black_reached: Blak i kamap long haus lain bilong waitman.
outcome.white_captured: Ol i kisim olgeta waitpela pilai.
outcome.black_captured: Ol i kisim olgeta hap bilong ol blak.
outcome.no_moves: Man {player_id} i no gat moa pasin bilong go.
